FIRE_WEAKNESS.mechanism: Teal Mask Ogerpon ex is Grass-type, taking 2x weakness damage from Fire attacks.
FIRE_WEAKNESS.impact: 110+ Fire base damage deals 220+ damage, scoring instant 1-hit KOs on 210 HP Ogerpon.
FIRE_WEAKNESS.counter_family: Fire Basic Aggro (Gouging Fire ex / Hearthflame Ogerpon ex)

SAFEGUARD_ANTI_EX_IMMUNITY.mechanism: Ogerpon is exclusively a 2-prize Pokemon ex; Mimikyu/Miltank block all damage from ex Pokemon.
SAFEGUARD_ANTI_EX_IMMUNITY.impact: Ogerpon cannot damage Safeguard single-prize walls, forcing pass-turns and stall deckouts.
SAFEGUARD_ANTI_EX_IMMUNITY.counter_family: Single-Prize Anti-EX Wall (Mimikyu / Miltank / Crushing Hammer)

HIGH_HP_METAL_RESISTANCE.mechanism: Archaludon ex possesses 300 HP and Metal energy recovery, requiring 3+ attacks to breach.
HIGH_HP_METAL_RESISTANCE.impact: Absorbs multiple Ogerpon hits while trading 2-prize knockouts.
